[[Grognar's Blade]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[sword]] dropped by [[Grognard Gravelhead]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Sorrow's Furnace]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]] 15-22 (Requires 9 [[Swordsmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while in a [[Stance]])
:Lengthens [[Crippling|Crippled]] duration on foes by 33%
:[[Swordsmanship]] +1 (20% chance while using [[skills]])

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Long Sword]].

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Long Sword]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hulen Hairyback]], or [[Soros]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Crippling]] [[Sword Hilt]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Sword Pommel]] [[of Attribute|of Swordsmanship]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Dance with Death]]" inscription
